objective: Test whether an external-liquidity raid followed by a causal market-structure shift, failed order-block breaker conversion, overlapping same-direction fair-value gap and first completed-bar retracement produces repeatable after-cost Bybit-relevant alpha.

trader_explanation.bullish: Price raids confirmed sell-side liquidity, closes back above it, then displaces through the last confirmed internal swing high. The up-close candle around that internal high represented the bearish order block that drove the raid; the close above it proves failure and converts it into a bullish breaker. A classic bullish three-candle FVG must overlap that breaker. The first later completed bar that trades into the overlap and closes above its midpoint authorizes entry at the next exact one-minute open. Stop is beyond the raid and target is the nearest still-untaken opposing external liquidity.
trader_explanation.bearish: The exact mirror: buy-side liquidity raid, bearish structure shift, failed bullish order block converted into a bearish breaker, overlapping bearish FVG, first confirmed retracement, stop beyond the raid and target at opposing sell-side liquidity.

distinction_from_prior_work: The reported sweep-engulf and sweep-plus-FVG first-mitigation family did not require a previously identified order block to fail, breaker conversion, breaker-FVG price overlap, a first-retest lifecycle or an opposing external-liquidity target. This study tests that complete state transition rather than another engulfing threshold.

causal_definition.liquidity: Strict confirmed pivots known only width bars later, plus previous UTC-day high/low available at the new day boundary.
causal_definition.raid: Current wick trades beyond an active external level while the same completed bar closes back inside.
causal_definition.structure_shift: A later completed displacement bar closes through the last confirmed internal opposite pivot and through the failed order-block zone.
causal_definition.breaker: Bullish uses an up-close bearish-order-block candle around the internal high; bearish uses a down-close bullish-order-block candle around the internal low. The body or full range is frozen by candidate.
causal_definition.fvg: Classic three-candle same-direction gap formed on the structure-shift displacement bar.
causal_definition.unicorn_overlap: Positive price intersection between the breaker and FVG, measured relative to the smaller zone.
causal_definition.entry: First subsequent completed bar that intersects the overlap and closes beyond its midpoint; market entry at the next exact one-minute open.
causal_definition.exit: Protective stop beyond the raid or target at nearest still-untaken opposing confirmed swing/previous-day liquidity. No elapsed-time liquidation.
causal_definition.ambiguity: Protective stop before target when both are touched in one bar; adverse actual open for stop gaps; target filled no better than its frozen level.
causal_definition.unresolved: Source gap or period boundary before a strategy exit is retained as unresolved and fails the promotion gate.
